body:
## Features
- Tournament maps now download automatically for players and spectators.
- Replays now include their map and can recover older generated maps from saved settings when available.
- Added optional Linux AppImage registration for browser and Discord join links.

## Bug Fixes
- Fixed generated maps being missing from packaged tournament servers.
- Fixed generated-map sharing and map changes in LAN lobbies.
- Fixed installed maps becoming unavailable after delayed map searches.
- Fixed oversized cyan status bars on heavily damaged infantry.
- Repeated tournament joins now report that the player is already registered.
- Added the missing GDI Advanced Guard Tower foundation and matched Radar colors to other GDI buildings.

Update clients and servers to v0.97.4 before playing together. Replay playback still requires a compatible game version.
Linux link registration can also be enabled with `--register-links`.
